about: Fraterworks' free demonstration formulas, read from their PDFs on 2026-10-14.
Only the ingredient lists and amounts are copied; each formula links back to its PDF (and blog post where there is one).
Fraterworks: formulas are a guide only, used at the maker's own risk, and have not been tested for IFRA compliance.
Six PDFs are scanned images; those were read with OCR and checked against the page image by eye.
Some PDFs' printed TOTAL differs from the sum of their lines; the lines are kept as printed.
